    The deck group and the walk-class grading #

    Subsection 4.2 (subsec:universal-cover, scalar-normalization.tex): "Let K̃ be the universal cover of K, constructed from walks starting at a basepoint, modulo edge cancellation and the triangle relations. The fundamental group G acts on this cover by deck transformations." A lifted vertex is a vertex X with the class of a walk from the basepoint; a path of Γ lifts uniquely from a chosen lift of its source.

    Formally we fix a basepoint v₀ and adjoin to K a cone of edges s_X : v₀ → X without triangles. This makes the complex connected without changing the argument (the source assumes A connected; with the cone, the cover is a disjoint union of universal covers of the components of K, and G is still free by the collapse of Lemma 4.2). The lift (X, h) of X in sheet h ∈ G is the walk class h · s_X; a path p : X → Y lifts from sheet h to sheet h · deg p, where deg p = s_X p s_Y⁻¹ (degW). Mesh relations are homogeneous for deg (their terms are homotopic to t_X), so deg grades C(Q, c) (WeightGrading.lean): this is the covering formula eq:walk-hom-sum. Edges have length one, translation edges length two and cone edges length zero; triangles preserve length, so length is a homomorphism ℓ : G → ℤ with ℓ (deg p) = |p| (len_degW); this is the height of the source.
